messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error in Math.factor(1L) : ‘round’ not meaningful for factors Calls: g.shell.GGIR -> g.part4 ->
parts:
Did you try starting again with a clean output folder and/or setting
overwrite = TRUE?
Changing input arguments mid-way and analysis can sometimes confuse GGIR.
Also, the errors seems related to your sleeplog. Try loading your
sleeplog files with function g.loadlog only and if that doesn't work
then it indicates that something is wrong with your sleeplog file.
Vincent
